title: Host tests: rf_health CMake -std flag surgery fails confusingly if COMPILE_OPTIONS unset
description: lichen/tests/rf_health/CMakeLists.txt:24-27 uses get_target_property + REMOVE_ITEM to swap -std=c23 for -std=c2x (gcc-13 on the Linux builder). If lichen_test_target is ever bypassed/reordered, get_target_property returns RF_HEALTH_OPTS-NOTFOUND which lands on the compiler command line as a filename. Robust fix: check_c_compiler_flag probe in lichen/tests/cmake/test_common.cmake (benefits all host tests) or list(FILTER ... EXCLUDE REGEX '^-std='). Found in edge-cases review of bead 0hvq (worker1).
